title: NC DEQ FINAL 2022 Integrated Report — original Savannah assessment source
notes: Original NC DEQ service metadata, counts, object-ID inventories, attributes, parameter records and complete selected geometries are retained unchanged.
Station HUC8 uses unpadded text3060101; stream and polygon HUC8 are integer3060101/3060102. Original padded-string empty response is also retained.
The parameter table contains75 rows with CYCLE2022 and2 rows with CYCLE2020. Keep CYCLE, ASMNT_DATE and COLLECTION_YEAR distinct from service edition and retrieval date.
The HUC8 query is an acquisition scope. Actual selected217-HUC geometry intersection and scientific normalization remain with the existing assessment owner.
